Subject: High failure rate during peak - possible warmup starvation

Hi Laura,

We observed a sharp increase in inference failures this morning during our 02:00–02:20 UTC traffic spike. Impact summary: ~14 minutes of 5xx/timeout responses, roughly 18% of requests failing for the tenant serving model "cm-small-v1". User-facing errors manifested as retries and checkout failures. Attached is a zipped bundle of request logs and a short trace excerpt (clearmind_logs_20270426.zip, trace-req-8a7b.txt).

Can you confirm:
- Whether this maps to an availability SLO/creditable downtime window?
- What the eligible remedy would be (pro-rated credit, one-time credit, or contract exception)?
- ETA for a postmortem and whether Redwood can share raw traces to our security team?

This hit our production checkout between 02:14:12 and 02:28:01 UTC. Please treat this as urgent — we had a material revenue impact during a campaign spike. Happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Thanks,
Sophie Grant

Laura / team — quick technical readout from triage (summary first, details below).

Summary: warmup starvation caused the observed spike. During a model-swap event in the US-E region at ~02:10 UTC the autoscaler initiated a thin scaling operation; several inference hosts served cold KV caches and the runtime dropped to single-digit throughput for short periods. As client requests retried, we saw 503 and timeout responses. This aligns with the 02:14–02:28 window Sophie reported. Evidence:
- Per-host tail latency increased to 4.2s p95->p99 for the tenant's model.
- 5xx rate peaked at ~18% for the tenant, total failed requests ~3,600 over the 14-minute window.
- Trace sample (trace-req-8a7b.txt) shows repeated cache misses and model reload latency.

Eligibility & recommended remedy:
- The window meets our definition for proportional SLA relief (service availability drop > threshold for tenant tier).
- Recommend a proportional credit: compute on a pro-rata basis for impacted minutes relative to monthly billing. Early estimate attached as credit_calc.xlsx (e.g., ~2.1% of the billing for the affected day for the tenant; final number subject to exact minute-level weighting).

Remediation notes to share with customer:
1) Immediate: pin their production route to a warm pool / pre-warmed replicas for the next 72 hours to avoid cold-starts while we root-cause.
2) Medium-term: adjust autoscaler cooldown and increase prefetch size for the model family.
3) Long-term: add model warming during deployments and increase KV cache persistence across instances.

Retention & sharing: we'll retain relevant raw traces for 90 days; we can share redacted traces with Clearmind's security team under existing NDA.

Next actions:
- Laura: propose credit and PM/mtg to customer.
- Aditya: coordinate legal/procurement flows if Clearmind requests a credit memo or DocuSign.
- Hannah: schedule postmortem invite for Wednesday (Apr 28) and include SRE/Runtime/Customer.

I'll attach the short telemetry snapshot (already added to the Drive link Laura shared).

-Karthik

Sophie — thanks again for raising this and for your patience while we validated. Below is what we have verified and next steps.

What we verified:
- Confirmed impacted window: 2027-04-26 02:14:12–2027-04-26 02:28:01 UTC.
- Confirmed client-observed symptoms map to elevated 5xx and timeout rates from our telemetry (tenant-level failure rate ~18%, ~3.6k failed requests).
- Cause: warmup starvation during a model-swap + autoscaler thin-scaling event (per Karthik's note).

Remedy offered:
- Eligibility: Clearmind qualifies for a proportional SLA credit under your contract.
- Proposed credit: preliminary figure of ~2.1% pro-rata for the affected billing period (credit_calc.xlsx attached). Final credit will be calculated after minute-level weighting and agreed by finance.
- Credit mechanics: credit issued as an invoice adjustment or account credit applied to the next invoice; timeline: finance/ billing aims to process within 30 days after acceptance.

Postmortem & remediation:
- We have scheduled a postmortem review for Wed, Apr 28 at 1600 UTC (invite sent; Hannah is coordinating the invite and agenda).
- We will share a redacted evidence bundle in the Drive folder (link below) and can provide raw traces to your security contact under NDA.

Links & artifacts:
- Evidence folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cEvidence

- If you want the raw traces shared directly, confirm the security contact and we'll coordinate with legal.

I'll wait for your acceptance of the credit proposal and any questions ahead of the postmortem. Apologies again for the impact — our SRE team will follow up with concrete mitigation steps and a timeline for the autoscaler/warmup fixes.
